text: Powder's dry, flints are sharp. What are you shooting at?
{npc}. Pistols, muskets, blunderbusses. All guaranteed not to explode. Mostly.
Careful with that, it's loaded. No, the other one.
Keep your voice down. There are marines about, and your face is on the posters.
I'll serve you, but quickly. Bounty hunters drink in here.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Pistol's quick to draw and quick to reload. Musket hits far and hard. Blunderbuss empties a deck at close range.
A good shot with a pistol beats a bad one with a cannon.
A rifling kit cuts grooves in the barrel. More bite per shot. Three goes at it, if your hands are steady enough.
A customer once brought me a pistol from the Sovereign Dawn. Forty years underwater and it still fired. Wouldn't sell it to me, either.
